# Speaker selector (`speaker-selector`)

Rooms and speakers to send playback to and group together, each with its own volume.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createSpeakerSelector` (types in `dist/web/home/media-voice/speakerSelector.d.ts`): `.mh-speaker-selector`: a `<fieldset>` (hidden legend) with a `__list` of `__item`s (`.is-selected`, `.is-playing`, `.is-unavailable`). Each item is a `<label>` `__pick` (the `__badge` icon, `__text` with `__name` and `__detail`, three `__bars` while playing, and a native checkbox, or a radio with `multiple: false`, drawn like `.mh-checkbox` / `.mh-radio`), and while picked its own `__volume` row: a `__mute` toggle and a `__level` range that commits on release.

```ts
export function createSpeakerSelector(options: SpeakerSelectorOptions): SpeakerSelectorHandle;

export interface SpeakerSelectorOptions extends SpeakerSelectorData, SpeakerSelectorEvents {}

export interface SpeakerSelectorHandle {
  el: HTMLFieldSetElement;
  update(options: SpeakerSelectorOptions): void;
}

export interface SpeakerSelectorData {
  speakers: readonly Speaker[];
  /** Group them: several can be picked (checkboxes, default). `false`: one at a time (radios). */
  multiple?: boolean;
  /** Accessible name of the set (default "Play on"). */
  label?: string;
  labels?: Partial<SpeakerSelectorLabels>;
}

export interface SpeakerSelectorEvents {
  /** A speaker was picked or left out. With `multiple: false`, only picks are reported. */
  onSelect?: (id: string, selected: boolean) => void;
  /** 0 to 1, when a volume slider is released (or a key changes it). */
  onVolume?: (id: string, volume: number) => void;
  onMute?: (id: string, muted: boolean) => void;
}

/** Every word the selector shows or speaks. `{name}` is the speaker's name. */
export interface SpeakerSelectorLabels {
  group: string;
  playing: string;
  unavailable: string;
  volume: string;
  mute: string;
  empty: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createSpeakerSelector, type Speaker, type SpeakerSelectorEvents } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

let speakers: Speaker[] = [
  { id: 'living', name: 'Living room', detail: 'Soundbar', selected: true, volume: 0.42, muted: false },
  { id: 'kitchen', name: 'Kitchen', detail: 'Shelf speaker', selected: true, volume: 0.25, muted: false },
  { id: 'study', name: 'Study', detail: 'Desk speaker', volume: 0.5, muted: false },
];

const change = (id: string, patch: Partial<Speaker>): void => {
  speakers = speakers.map((s) => (s.id === id ? { ...s, ...patch } : s));
  selector.update({ speakers, multiple: true, ...events });
};

const events: SpeakerSelectorEvents = {
  onSelect: (id, selected) => change(id, { selected }),
  onVolume: (id, volume) => change(id, { volume, muted: false }),
  onMute: (id, muted) => change(id, { muted }),
};

const selector = createSpeakerSelector({ speakers, multiple: true, ...events });

document.body.append(selector.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { SpeakerSelector } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { Speaker } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

export function SpeakerSelectorExample() {
  const [speakers, setSpeakers] = useState<Speaker[]>([
    { id: 'living', name: 'Living room', detail: 'Soundbar', selected: true, volume: 0.42, muted: false },
    { id: 'kitchen', name: 'Kitchen', detail: 'Shelf speaker', selected: true, volume: 0.25, muted: false },
    { id: 'study', name: 'Study', detail: 'Desk speaker', volume: 0.5, muted: false },
  ]);
  const change = (id: string, patch: Partial<Speaker>) =>
    setSpeakers((list) => list.map((s) => (s.id === id ? { ...s, ...patch } : s)));
  return (
    <SpeakerSelector
      speakers={speakers}
      multiple
      onSelect={(id, selected) => change(id, { selected })}
      onVolume={(id, volume) => change(id, { volume, muted: false })}
      onMute={(id, muted) => change(id, { muted })}
    />
  );
}
```
